title: Oracle reports Q3 revenue up 22% YoY to $17.19B, vs. $16.91B est., and cloud revenue up 44% to $8.9B, vs. $8.85B est.; ORCL jumps 6%+ after hours (Jordan Novet/CNBC)
summary: Jordan Novet / CNBC: Oracle reports Q3 revenue up 22% YoY to $17.19B, vs. $16.91B est., and cloud revenue up 44% to $8.9B, vs. $8.85B est.; ORCL jumps 6%+ after hours — Oracle shares rose 6% in extended trading on Tuesday after the database software maker reported quarterly results that surpassed Wall Street projections.
